mechanism: Ritonavir is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase alpha lipoic acid metabolism and exposure, while alpha lipoic acid may theoretically affect ritonavir levels through hepatic enzyme modulation.
action: Monitor for altered efficacy of ritonavir-based antiretroviral therapy; consider therapeutic drug monitoring of ritonavir levels if alpha lipoic acid is added to an established regimen.
